summary: PropManage FAZA A (First Revenue) tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (war-room GET, mark-sold on published listing produces 6250 RON gross commission at 250k price, listing becomes 'sold' + disappears from public, mark-sold on draft returns 400 in RO, admin sales list + extended stats OK, VE checkout demo regression OK). Frontend: /admin/war-room renders full UI (title, mission banner, 9 milestones incl. milestone-first_customer, founder-actions with Stripe LIVE + Resend blockers, morning-briefing with 3 questions). Sidebar 'War Room' link present in /admin. VE Admin Kanban shows all 5 stages incl. kanban-col-sold, 2x kanban-sold-* buttons on published cards, 'Vândute' + 'Comision net (RON)' stats visible. Public detail page: detail-open-twin has href='/demo' for demo listing (fix confirmed — no longer always redirects), inquiry-form-viewing renders. Cleanup: reverted sold listing to published, deleted sale doc, removed 4 leftover TEST_ listings from previous iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: war_room endpoint recomputes started_at from ISO string on every call; harmless but consider caching.

mark_sold recalculates commission_net using twin deduction only if source_order package in (twin,bundle); demo listings without source_order_id return commission_net == commission_gross (as expected but documented poorly).
get_checkout_status polls Stripe on pending non-demo orders — good, robust to missed webhooks.
Sidebar War Room link visibility gated by super-admin role — verified only via UI presence, not role logic.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test creates transient draft only if none exist; all TEST_ prefixed data cleaned in fixture teardown. Additionally removed 4 legacy TEST_Draft No Gates listings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is at /login (NOT /auth — /auth redirects to /). Cookie-based auth: axios must use withCredentials:true. Stripe is in DEMO mode (sk_test_emergent placeholder) → real payment can't be tested here, only demo flow. Resend DNS blocker is expected in preview (action_required). War Room correctly shows both blockers as 'external' founder actions. When testing 'first listing' on /imobile-verificate, filter out /imobile-verificate/sell nav link (matches a[href^='/imobile-verificate/']). MongoDB DB_NAME is 'propmanage_db' (not 'propmanage'). All 7 backend tests + all 9 frontend checks passed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all board-approved FAZA A changes verified functional.
